* '''PC-E3''' ([[Your Ship? (V) (Errata 3)]]): Partial slip in the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="dskit2024-slip">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024), page 2: partial slip labelled “•Your Ship?”. Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF itself is dated by its creation date.</ref>: “Plays on table. Cancels A Dangerous Time, Bad Feeling Have I, Colo Claw Fish, Field Promotion, and Imperial Supply. Each player may play only one card with “sabacc” in title each turn. You may lose 1 Force to cancel a card with “sabacc” in title.” '''What changed:''' Same words as the 22 July 2024 card image ([[Your Ship? (V) (Errata 2)]]). The kit prints the card as a partial slip — the “DEFENSIVE SHIELD” band and the game-text box only (no title, picture or lore) — with the lower-left name and the errata mark “E1” at the bottom, to be laid over a printed card. A separate PC publication that looks visibly different from the card image, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication and every visible change is a version). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints “E1” but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
